name: Chijoku Tsuma Sayoko ~Musuko to Musuko no Tomodachi~
original_name: 恥辱妻・小夜子～息子と息子の友達～
source:
Sayoko is a middle-aged married woman who still keeps a girly air.
Her son, Shun is a good boy and her days were peaceful, until the day when her son's friend, Yuto, asks for her body.
